en.headline: Customs seizes 4kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport, arrests mainland man
en.dek: A 28-year-old mainland passenger arriving from Bangkok was arrested after officers found about 4 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds worth an estimated HK$900,000 in his checked luggage.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it detected a drug-trafficking case at Hong Kong International Airport on Monday involving about 4 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of HK$900,000.
The 28-year-old mainland man arrived from Bangkok. Officers examining his checked suitcase found the suspected drugs and arrested him. The case remains under investigation.

Customs urged the public not to accept requests to carry controlled items into or out of Hong Kong and warned that trafficking dangerous drugs carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢4公斤懷疑大麻花 拘28歲內地男子
zh.dek: 一名28歲內地男旅客由曼谷抵港，海關在其寄艙行李箱內發現約4公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約90萬元，男子已被捕。
body: 香港海關周一在香港國際機場偵破一宗行李藏毒案件，檢獲約4公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約90萬元，拘捕一名28歲內地男子。
該名男子當日從泰國曼谷飛抵本港。海關人員替他清關時，在其攜同的寄艙行李箱內發現該批懷疑大麻花，遂把他拘捕。案件仍在調查中。
海關呼籲市民切勿貪圖金錢利益參與販毒活動，不要接受任何人士聘請或委託運送受管制物品進出香港。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
